status: Five best-effort returns saved; exact silhouette and fully flat albedo requirements were not met within the permitted attempts.
selection_note: Selected means best retained attempt for the named deliverable, not full brief compliance.
validation_method: Read PNG metadata and alpha; visually compare all returns to guides/reference. Diagnostic mask IoU compares alpha >=128 after nearest-neighbor normalization to guide size in memory only; delivered PNG bytes are unchanged.

runs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: orthographic albedo texture source for the Hesper carapace mail, overlapping plates of Kreegan chitin-alloy cut from fallen Troopers.
Input image 1 is design_reference.png: MATERIAL AND COLOUR AUTHORITY ONLY, not camera or silhouette. Input image 2 is the named guide: EDIT TARGET and absolute authority for geometry, silhouette, all openings, every edge and panel, camera orientation, position and scale.
Paint directly over the exact white/grey geometry of input image 2. Keep its exact 1024 x 1024 canvas and alpha silhouette, every protrusion, internal transparent hole, jagged edge, framing and pixel position. Preserve even unusual camera directions. Do not turn the object upright, reinterpret the view name, change perspective, move, rescale, expand or crop the geometry. Do not replace this guide with the reference's attractive three-quarter pose.
Apply the design reference's actual materials: muted dark violet and black-purple mottled chitin-alloy overlapping plates with fine warm worn edges and fine hairline cracks; warm ivory bone/ceramic claw-shaped edging with small beige wear marks; dark warm brown leather straps and stitched lining; restrained brushed antique gold/brass buckles. Only where the existing chest light element is visible, paint its inset a bright orange/amber light colour. Continue materials plausibly on unseen backs and undersides. Keep every part and seam at its guide location. Do not invent extra structures, symbols, trim, holes or markings.
LIGHTING: pure painted base colour/albedo under completely flat even shadowless illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient occlusion darkening between parts, no edge shadows, no strong specular highlights, no reflections, no rim light, no cinematic gradient, no glowing light spill or bloom. Metal has its base colour with at most a faint sheen. Existing light recess is bright painted orange. Surface variation comes from the materials' colour and fine wear, not lighting.
Return one 1024 x 1024 RGBA PNG on a truly transparent background, including transparent holes in the guide. No background, floor, checkerboard drawn into the image, text, letters, labels, watermark or multiple-view sheet. Do not add any pixels outside the guide's silhouette.
VIEW: guide_front.png. This is the short, strongly foreshortened annular end-on view shown in image 2. Preserve its roughly oval outer outline within x=179..844, y=244..780 and its large polygonal central transparent opening centered near (510,500). Follow the guide rather than a conventional upright front view. The broad inside surfaces are brown leather lining; exterior plate faces are violet chitin. Keep all pointed plate lips and bands exactly as modeled.
runs.reason: Rejected: enlarged object, invented panel boundaries, strong lighting and poor guide alignment (normalized mask IoU 0.529).
